items.name: Asymptotic tracking
items.definition: Asymptotic tracking：The property of a control system where the tracking error approaches zero as time goes to infinity.

items.name: Phase-Lead Compensator
items.definition: Phase-Lead Compensator：A first-order compensator where |z|<|p|, providing a phase-lead characteristic.

items.name: z-transform
items.definition: z-transform：A transform defined as Z{r(t)} = Z{r*(t)} = sum_{k=0}^{∞} r(kT) z^{-k}, where z = e^{sT}.

items.name: Sampled-data system
items.definition: Sampled-data system：A system where part of the system acts on sampled data.

items.name: 自激振荡
items.definition: 所谓自激振荡是指没有外界信号的作用时，系统内产生的具有固定振幅和频率的稳定周期运动，简称自振。
